note: Prebuilt rule names are best effort; confirm against the deployed 9.5.3 prebuilt rules package. Entries with verify=true are uncertain. configure.sh should match by name via /api/detection_engine/rules/_find and enable them. T1071.001, T1560.001 and T1048.003 steps are telemetry-only for hunting; no prebuilt rule is expected. The logon-failure rule needs Windows Security logs (system integration) and may exclude loopback sources, hence the spray targets the VM's own private IP.
